fiber.signature: pub fn fiber(&self, locals: (usize, usize)) -> Result<JointFiber, JointError>

G5: Let nL,nR be local real-state counts, aL,aR alphabets, m relation rows, f selected fiber rows. Checked estimate is (nL+1)^2(aL+1)+(nR+1)^2(aR+1)+3m and refuses overflow before quotienting/admission. It bounds declared cell work, not tree comparisons/allocator overhead or time. Already supplied Vec storage and caller construction are outside this admission.

Each local quotient does at most N-1 strict splits plus a fixed-point step; N=n+1. Each refinement builds N signatures of width a+1 and performs ordered-map interning, so a safe comparison-work bound is O(N^2*(a+1)*log(N+1)) including worst-case signature comparisons, and O(N^2+N*(a+1)) retained/scratch elements plus tree overhead. Owned quotient tables/maps and partitions are required by that provider API. Constructor performs one quotient per component, drops only the internal sink map entry, and allocates one necessary report pair per admitted row. No component quotient or transition table is recomputed inside the relation loop.

Relation deduplication is O(m log(m+1)) fixed-width pair comparisons; validation/pair report building O(m). factor_tables/decide and width-three profile interning cost O(m log(m+1)) fixed-width integer comparisons and O(m) output/intermediate entries. Three-element Vec rows are required owned family inputs; there are no cloned local quotient snapshots or temporary String tuple keys per row.

fiber membership is O(nL+nR), row scan O(m), answer-set construction O(f log(f+1)), required output O(f). verify_analysis and verify_fiber intentionally reconstruct these outputs and compare fully, with the same asymptotic bounds, rather than trusting a caller receipt. pairs borrows O(1). Standard Clone/Eq/Debug derive costs are proportional to visited stored/output structure; no hidden law or resource certification.
